games.name: 🌸 Fruit Juice Tycoon: Refreshed
games.desc:
THE DEVELOPER BIRTHDAY BASH BEGINS! Birthday items return for a short time as balloons swarm the map! The summer event has also been extended by a week, with various improvements and boosts to help you finish off your journey to sparkling coconut mastery!

Relive a 2010 classic with this expanded remake! This fan-made "refreshed" version brings the game closer to modern Roblox standards with new mechanics and polished visuals, while still trying to keep a similar feel to the original gameplay. 

This game is still in development. Your progress, unlocks, and stats will never be erased by updates, but adjustments may be made. 

Your feedback means the world to us! Big or small, send it our way in the group wall or our community server. 

This game is maintained and monetized with the full permission of the original creator of FJT, tycoonworldmaker. If you own VIP from the original game, it will work here.

games.name: STARBASE
games.desc:
Ramming Speed Update!
- New Energy Ram Weapon!
- New NPC Freighters to Escort or Plunder!
- New Pacific American Gamepass!
- New visual effects! 

Discover the expanse of the galaxy with over 200 ships across a huge procedurally generated solar system with fully explorable planets.
